data.summary: The Bußgeldstelle of Musterwilhelmshaven issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) with a total amount of €92.00 (Aktenzeichen 32.12-26/61107) because the vehicle WHV-FM 88 was driven on 1 October 2026 with its roadworthiness inspection (Hauptuntersuchung) more than four months overdue. The violation adds 1 point to the driving record (Fahreignungsregister).
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) for driving a vehicle whose inspection (Hauptuntersuchung) was overdue by more than four months. The city set a fine of €60 plus fees, for a total of €92, and will register 1 point against the driving record. You may file an objection (Einspruch) if you disagree, and the app will show until when based on the delivery date shown on the envelope. If no objection is filed, the notice becomes final and the total amount becomes due two weeks after that; the app cannot show that payment date in advance since it depends on whether you object. Consider legal advice if you want to contest it.

items.title: File an objection (Einspruch) against the fine notice
items.action: If you disagree with the fine, submit a written objection (Einspruch) to the Bußgeldstelle, or have it recorded in person, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the fine notice becomes final (rechtskräftig) and enforceable, and the total amount falls due two weeks after that.

items.action: Pay the total amount of €92.00 to the Bußgeldstelle once the notice becomes final; the app will show the due date after the objection period shown has passed without an objection being filed.
items.consequence: Late payment can lead to enforcement (Vollstreckungsmaßnahmen).
